items.defectStatement: Each retrieval of an unknown embed URL synchronously downloads and processes the entire configured feed. Because retrieval throttling is per article URL, requests for different articles repeatedly trigger this work.
obligations: Bound request-triggered full-feed polling across different embed URLs.
Retain the existing-embed check after polling.
Preserve HTTP retrieval when the requested embed remains missing.
Preserve independently scheduled feed imports.
items.exampleFix:
if SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?
        feed_poll_key = "embed:feed-poll:#{Time.now.to_i / 60}"
        if $redis.setnx(feed_poll_key, "1")
          $redis.expire(feed_poll_key, 120)
          Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})
        end
        return if TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: @embed_url).exists?
items.notes: This bounds request-triggered polling to once per fixed minute; an admitted poll still processes the full feed. Targeted importing is another solution but requires changes to PollFeed, which currently ignores execute arguments.

items.defectStatement: The public endpoint enqueues retrieval for every unknown embed URL without a client-wide limit. Varying paths or query strings bypasses the downstream exact-URL throttle, allowing excessive jobs, network requests, and potentially duplicate article topics.
obligations: Limit retrieval enqueueing using an identity independent of the supplied embed URL.
Enforce the limit across concurrent requests and application workers.
Continue permitting anonymous retrieval within the limit.
Preserve rendering of already-existing topics.
items.exampleFix:
else
      retrieve_key = "embed:retrieve:#{request.remote_ip}:#{Time.now.to_i / 60}"
      if $redis.setnx(retrieve_key, "1")
        $redis.expire(retrieve_key, 120)
        Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, user_id: current_user.try(:id), embed_url: embed_url)
      end
      render 'loading'
items.notes: The repository provides a shared, site-namespaced $redis client, but that dependency is absent from this item's frozen input. The example permits one retrieval per IP per fixed minute; other reasonable limits are valid. Feed-specific throttling is addressed separately by #30.

items.defectStatement: absolutize_urls treats protocol-relative href and src values as paths on the article host, breaking external links and images. It also leaves path-relative values unresolved instead of resolving them against the article URL.
obligations: Preserve the destination host of protocol-relative links and images.
Resolve path-relative references against the article URL.
Preserve correct root-relative and already-absolute references.
Handle both anchor href and image src attributes, including documents without anchors.
items.notes: The cited range covers only the anchor branch. The independent image branch at lines 70–72 also needs correction; changing only href handling is incomplete.

items.defectStatement: import_remote uses open-uri, which follows redirects without repeating the initial embeddable-host validation. An allowed-host URL can therefore redirect the server to an internal service; the initial validation also permits unexpected schemes and ports.
obligations: Prevent redirects from causing requests to unvalidated destinations.
Restrict the initial request to the configured host over permitted HTTP(S) schemes and ports.
Continue passing successful response bodies to Readability with the existing options.
Do not import redirect or unsuccessful response bodies as articles.
items.exampleFix:
require 'net/http'
    require 'openssl'

    uri = URI.parse(url)
    return unless %w[http https].include?(uri.scheme) && uri.host == SiteSetting.embeddable_host
    return unless uri.port == (uri.scheme == 'https' ? 443 : 80)

    http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port, nil)
    http.use_ssl = uri.scheme == 'https'
    http.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER if http.use_ssl?
    http.open_timeout = 10
    http.read_timeout = 10
    response = http.start { |connection| connection.get(uri.request_uri) }
    return unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)

    doc = Readability::Document.new(response.body,
items.notes: Rejecting all redirects fixes the confirmed redirect bypass without needing a new application helper. This example does not claim protection against the configured hostname itself resolving to private addresses or DNS rebinding. A timeout alone does not fix the bypass.

items.defectStatement: PollFeed calls scrub on i.content even when a feed item supplies only description. The resulting NoMethodError aborts processing of that item and all remaining feed items.
obligations: Use description when content is absent.
Skip items with no usable body without aborting subsequent items.
Preserve scrubbing and HTML entity decoding for imported bodies.
items.exampleFix:
body = i.content.presence || i.description
        next if body.blank?
        content = CGI.unescapeHTML(body.scrub)
items.notes: Falling back for blank content as well as nil is valid. Converting nil directly to an empty string avoids the exception but loses description-only articles.

items.defectStatement: TopicEmbed.import interpolates the source URL unescaped into both an HTML attribute and link text in a raw-HTML post, allowing markup injection. Appending the footer with << also raises when contents is nil.
obligations: Escape the URL for both the quoted href attribute and visible link text.
Handle nil contents without raising.
Preserve the article body and translated attribution footer.
Keep the original URL unchanged for embed lookup and storage.
items.notes: Constructing the link with Nokogiri is also valid. Escaping must include apostrophes because href uses single quotes. All supplied local replacements passed Ruby syntax compilation in their surrounding files; runtime tests were not run.

items.defectStatement: The disabled-polling spec leaves both the feed URL and embedding username blank, so those guards independently prevent polling. It therefore passes even if the enabled-flag check is removed.
obligations: Keep feed_polling_enabled? false.
Set both the feed URL and embedding username to nonblank values.
Retain the no-polling assertion so removing the enabled-flag guard fails the example.
items.exampleFix:
it "requires feed_polling_enabled?" do
      SiteSetting.stubs(:feed_polling_enabled?).returns(false)
      SiteSetting.stubs(:feed_polling_url).returns(url)
      SiteSetting.stubs(:embed_by_username).returns(embed_by_username)
      poller.expects(:poll_feed).never
      poller.execute({})
    end
items.notes: The surrounding context already supplies suitable URL and username values.

items.defectStatement: The URL and username prerequisite specs leave polling disabled, so execute skips poll_feed before testing either prerequisite. Other blank defaults also mask removal of the individual checks.
obligations: Enable polling in both examples.
Provide a nonblank username when testing the missing URL.
Provide a nonblank URL when testing the missing username.
Retain assertions that poll_feed is never called, with each example failing if its corresponding guard is removed.
items.exampleFix:
it "requires feed_polling_url" do
      SiteSetting.stubs(:feed_polling_enabled?).returns(true)
      SiteSetting.stubs(:feed_polling_url).returns(nil)
      SiteSetting.stubs(:embed_by_username).returns(embed_by_username)
      poller.expects(:poll_feed).never
      poller.execute({})
    end

    it "requires embed_by_username" do
      SiteSetting.stubs(:feed_polling_enabled?).returns(true)
      SiteSetting.stubs(:feed_polling_url).returns(url)
      SiteSetting.stubs(:embed_by_username).returns(nil)
      poller.expects(:poll_feed).never
      poller.execute({})
    end
items.notes: Stubbing only feed_polling_enabled? to true, as suggested in the finding, is insufficient because the other required setting defaults to blank.

items.defectStatement: EmbedController and TopicRetriever compare URI hosts with SiteSetting.embeddable_host case-sensitively, rejecting otherwise matching hosts whose letter case differs.
obligations: Compare hostnames case-insensitively in both referer validation and embed URL validation.
Continue rejecting different hosts, missing hosts, and malformed URLs.
Preserve rejection when the configured embeddable host is blank.
items.notes: The controller check alone is locally fixable, but the finding explicitly includes lib/topic_retriever.rb, whose implementation is absent from the frozen input. Handle nil URI hosts safely.

items.defectStatement: The precompile configuration omits embed.css and embed.js, leaving the iframe stylesheet and external embedding script unavailable in deployments relying on precompiled assets. The layout references embed.css; it does not itself reference embed.js.
obligations: Include embed.css and embed.js in the production asset precompile targets.
Preserve existing precompile targets.
Keep the iframe stylesheet reference resolving to the compiled embed stylesheet.
items.notes: The cited stylesheet helper is a consumer, not the defective configuration. The fix belongs in config/application.rb, which is not shown in the frozen input; deleting the helper or adding a script tag does not fix asset compilation.
